in_english.long_meaning: Mukhallad is a name that means relied, trusted, chosen, desired, expected. It means that one who trusts in Allah, relies on Allah, and expects Allah's mercy and blessings. The root of the name Mukhallad is Kh-L-D, which means to rely, trust, and expect. In Islamic tradition, Mukhallad is considered a name that conveys trust, reliance, and expectation in Allah. It is a name that reminds one of the importance of trusting in Allah and relying on His mercy and blessings. Mukhallad is a name that is commonly used in many Muslim cultures and communities, and it is a name that is associated with positive qualities such as trust, reliance, and expectation.
